moves.name: David Montgomery
moves.text: Hold David Montgomery (HOU RB) - RotoWire: "week-to-week" (Oct 12); out Weeks 7-8, back about Week 9 (Week 8 is his bye); ~9.3 a game when healthy. Once back he is worth ~22 pts to the best lineup through Week 17, more than the cheapest other bench seat, Harold Fannin Jr. (CLE TE, ~2 pts). If a roster seat is needed while he is out, free that one instead. Dom's call - never an order.
